description: Use this tool when a brand wants Digital Product Passports (DPP), QR codes and a consumer page for its products, in one step. It is the DEFAULT for new products: do not chain create_product_twin, create_dpp and create_data_carrier when this one does the job. INPUT: products (name, sku, gtin, composition, country of manufacture, care, materials... any shape, same as create_product_twin) and optionally units per product (how many physical units will carry a serial QR). For each product it creates the live twin in Cycle, publishes the versioned passport when the data is complete and the GTIN is valid (otherwise a 'preparatory' passport that lists what is missing) and returns the twin URL, the passport URL and a QR (SVG link ready to print). Free up to 1,000,000 physical units per connected free workspace (total, not monthly). Brand and product data are stored in Cycle under the connected brand. Not an official certification; EU registry submission is separate.

units.description: Optional {sku_or_name: units} map of serialized units to reserve per product
